lines.beaver_en: Wow, is this a family photo? Who is this?
lines.en: That's my father. He is an office worker.

lines.beaver_en: What is your father good at?
lines.en: My father is good at cooking.
My mother is a housewife. She's good at singing.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, your mother is like a singer!
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 저는 노래를 잘 못해요.
lines.en: Yes, but I'm not good at singing.
lines.roman: Ne, geureonde jeoneun noraereul jal motaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is this your older brother? He looks cool!
lines.learner: 네, 우리 형이에요. 지금 서른 살이에요.
lines.en: Yes, that's my older brother. He's thirty now.
lines.roman: Ne, uri hyeongieyo. Jigeum seoreun sarieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is he an actor or a singer?
lines.en: No, my brother is a doctor.

lines.beaver_en: Is your brother good at studying?
lines.learner: 네, 공부를 아주 잘해요. 그래서 의사가 됐어요.
lines.en: Yes, he's very good at studying. So he became a doctor.
lines.roman: Ne, gongbureul aju jalhaeyo. Geuraeseo uisaga dwaesseoyo.

lines.en: She's my younger sister. She's an actor.

lines.learner: 아직 유명하지 않아요. 그래서 아르바이트도 해요.
lines.en: She's not famous yet. So she also has a part-time job.
lines.roman: Ajik yumyeonghaji anayo. Geuraeseo areubaiteudo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 가족 모두 멋있어요. 보여 줘서 고마워요!
lines.beaver_en: Your whole family is great. Thanks for showing me!
lines.beaver_roman: Gajok modu meosisseoyo. Boyeo jwoseo gomawoyo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 다음엔 민수 씨의 가족도 보여 줘요.
lines.en: Thanks. Next time, show me your family too, Minsu.
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Daeumen minsu ssiui gajokdo boyeo jwoyo.
